scenario: VAT rounding caused €0.01 discrepancies on multi-line sales invoices.
why: VAT is now calculated per line then summed, instead of summed then taxed.

scenario: VAT rounding caused €0.01 discrepancies on multi-line sales invoices.
why: Added VATRoundingMode field to Sales Line table for per-line precision.

scenario: Inventory valuations were incorrect when posting partial shipments.
why: Item journal now recalculates average cost after partial instead of full shipment.

scenario: Sales team needed visibility into customer credit limits on the order screen.
why: Added CreditLimit and BalanceDue fields to Sales Order page, visible to Sales role.

scenario: Procurement needed a lead-time field per item on purchase lines.
why: Added VendorLeadTimeDays field to Sales Line so buyers can plan replenishment.

scenario: Sales orders were posting without checking if inventory was reserved for other customers.
why: Added inventory reservation check before posting. Orders now block if reserved stock falls below line quantity.

scenario: French customers required invoice layout conforming to Chorus Pro e-invoicing mandate.
why: Added Chorus Pro fields to Sales Invoice report: SIRET, engagement number, and legal footer per French regulation.

scenario: Customer onboarding required GDPR consent tracking before marketing emails could be sent.
why: Added GDPRConsentDate and MarketingOptIn fields to Customer table with validation before campaign exports.

scenario: Client migrated 2000+ customers from legacy CRM and needed bulk import with error reporting.
why: Added per-row error logging to Customer Import XMLport. Failed rows now written to a separate error table instead of aborting the entire import.

scenario: Purchase order approval workflow needed a 'Conditionally Approved' state for manager overrides.
why: Added ConditionallyApproved option to Approval Status enum with mandatory comment field requirement.

scenario: Sales dashboard was too slow loading customer rankings for accounts with 50k+ entries.
why: Rewrote Top Customers query with indexed date filters and materialized view pattern. Load time dropped from 8s to 0.3s.

scenario: Multi-currency sales orders were posting with incorrect exchange rates on partial shipments.
why: Exchange rate is now locked at order creation time instead of being re-fetched on every partial post.

scenario: Multi-currency sales orders were posting with incorrect exchange rates on partial shipments.
why: Added ExchangeRateLocked field to Sales Line to preserve original rate through partial shipments.

scenario: Warehouse needed automated EDI 856 (ASN) generation when shipments were confirmed.
why: Added OnAfterPostShipment event subscriber that triggers EDI 856 generation via EDI Connect.

scenario: Warehouse staff couldn't quickly identify items below reorder point during picking.
why: Added color-coded inventory status column to Item List page. Below reorder point shows red, above shows green.

scenario: Sales representatives needed read-only access to inventory levels without full warehouse permissions.
why: Extended BASIC-SALES permissionset with read-only access to Item and Inventory tables.

scenario: Finance team needed aging buckets in 15-day increments instead of 30-day for stricter collections.
why: Changed aging periods from 30-60-90 to 15-30-45-60-90 on Aged Receivables report and added average days to pay per customer.

scenario: Performance degraded on high-volume posting days (500+ orders/hour) due to row-level locking.
why: Refactored Sales-Post to batch commit every 100 lines instead of per-line. Posting throughput increased 4x.

scenario: Customer service needed to flag orders requiring manager approval before warehouse release.
why: Added RequiresApproval and ApprovedBy fields to Sales Header with validation gate before release-to-warehouse.

scenario: Account managers needed a 12-month order history graph on the customer card.
why: Added rolling 12-month order value chart to Customer Card page using on-demand query for performance.

scenario: Inventory manager needed to identify items with no movement in 90+ days for clearance sales.
why: Created Slow Movers query joining Item and Item Ledger Entry with 90-day no-activity filter and stock value.

scenario: Year-end required export of all G/L entries to external auditor's format.
why: Created G/L Export XMLport mapping standard BC fields to auditor's required CSV schema with validation checks.

scenario: Drop-ship orders needed to be distinguished from standard sales for warehouse routing.
why: Added DropShip option to Order Type enum. Warehouse pick list now skips drop-ship lines automatically.

scenario: Purchase order approval chain was linear but company needed parallel approvals above €50k.
why: Refactored Approval Mgt. codeunit to support parallel approval workflows. PO over threshold now requires both manager and finance director.

scenario: Sales line comments were being lost when orders were copied to purchase orders.
why: Added CopyComments field to Sales Line. When enabled, line comments transfer to purchase order on drop-ship.

scenario: Supplier required PO format matching their ERP system for automated processing.
why: Added custom PO layout with supplier-specific barcode and header format per vendor card settings.

scenario: Finance team manually reconciled 200+ bank transactions per week.
why: Integrated Bank Feed extension with auto-matching rules. Transactions matching amount + date + reference auto-reconcile.

scenario: Needed a common payment API so multiple PSPs could be plugged in without changing posting logic.
why: Defined PaymentProcessor interface with ProcessPayment and RefundPayment methods. Existing Stripe and SEPA codeunits now implement it.

scenario: Warehouse staff accidentally posted journals with negative quantities during stocktake.
why: Added validation on Item Journal page blocking negative quantity posting unless StocktakeMode is enabled.

scenario: Black Friday caused deadlocks when 1200 orders were posted simultaneously.
why: Implemented optimistic concurrency on Sales-Post. Contention dropped 90% under peak load.
